Troopers on post along the Mexican border using field telephone, keeping in touch with headquarters. The villainous raid into American territory by Villa and his bandits has caused the hurried despatch of United States troops to points along the Mexican border. Soldiers are stationed in small detachments and groups along the border-line and help in touch with the main division or headquarters by use of this field telephone. Villa and his man appeared suddenly in the town of Columbus, N.M., and opened fire on troops and civilians and set fire to all buildings possible. For two hours, troops and civilians fought Mexicans and fire at the same time. The Villaists then sounded the retreat and filed pursued by two troops of the 13th Cavalry who followed them into Mexico for a distance of fifteen miles. The American troops returned reporting Villa making a stand and that at least seventy-five of Villa's rear guard had been killed. 5/10/16.

Previous to the advent of the American forces in Mexico, things in northern Chilmachi went along in the same old hum-drum way in the few stray towns and villages that dotted that arid stretch.

Now there are signs of activity and snap throughout the whole section lying between the border and the American base camp. With motor trucks constantly flying between those points and stopping here and there things have taken & now turn. The old order has changed, & modern city has risen from the soil of Mexico one might stay almost in a night.

They solutions at the base camp have laid out streets, constructed Adobe huts from adobe mud, have arranged for fresh water supply, and have on the whole reconstructed the area, making it a near counter-part of a small city.

Simulation is this city's strong point. Disease has been reduced to a minimum. No refuse is allowed to collect and as several of the country's well-known sanitation experts are on hand there is little fear of the men becoming infected with tropical diseases. There are inconveniences about the mode of life; for instance, it is hot; but the Commissioner in Ohio can't remedy this, and that is the only reason it remains so. One must seek place under the shower or take an afternoon sista in one's shack.

The stabilizer weighs 120 tons. Operating of the common gyroscope, the stabilizer attained an overspeed of 10 per cent or 880 revolutions per minute. Its big wheel is propelled with such force that it would spin for eighteen hours after the power is shut off. The actions is controlled by small gyroscopes along the sides of the vessel. These register the direction of the roll and automatically start the big wheel revolving in the direction necessary to counteract the motion of the ship.
